REMOVED FROM COURT TRIAL CALENDAR ON AUG-12-2002 IN DEPT. 503 - MATTER ASSIGNED FROM DEPT. 206 FOR SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE. ALL PARTIES APPEARED. TERMS OF THE SETTLEMENT AS FOLLOWS: PLAINTIFF RUPERT PUPKIN PROPERTIES, LLC TO HAVE IMMEDIATE POSSESSION OF PROPERTY LOCATED AT 316 VALENCIA ST., #301, SAN FRANCISCO, CA. FROM DEFENDANTS MARCO VASQUEZ AND SONIA PENATE. LEASE FORFEITED. STAY UNTIL 5:00 P.M. OCTOBER 1, 2002. KEYS TO BE GIVEN TO THE MANAGER, HENRY BA. IF DEFENDANTS VACATE THE PREMISES ON OR BEFORE OCTOBER 1, 2002, PLAINTIFF WAIVES ALL BACK RENTS. UPON TIMELY RECEIPT OF THE KEYS, PLAINTIFF WILL PAY DEFENDANTS THE AMOUNT OF $3,000.00 (INCLUDES SECURITY DEPOSIT) IN CASH. EACH SIDE TO BEAR OWN COSTS AND ATTORNEY FEES. ANY ITEMS LEFT IN PREMISES AFTER OCT. 1, 2002 WILL BE DISPOSED OF. IF DEFENDANTS DO NOT COMPLY WITH THE AGREEMENT, PLAINTIFF WILL HAVE AN AMENDED JUDGMENT SIGNED AND DEFENDANTS WILL HAVE JUDGMENT FOR ALL RENTS DUE AND OWING, AND A WRIT TO ISSUE IMMEDIATELY. ALL PARTIES AGREED TO THE SETTLEMENT IN OPEN COURT. THE COURT STATED THAT THIS WAS JUDICIALLY SUPERVISED SETTLEMENT PURSUANT THE CCP 664.6. JUDGE CHIANTELLI; CLERK: V. MU; REPORTER: M. TORREANO, #8600 (503)
